results.title: A phone: the bar at the top, the page scrolls, sign-in stands out
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: the reader's bar sits at the top; the Tabs drawer closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself (so the browser's bars can fold away); signed out, the sign-in button is filled in the accent colour and keeps its account icon with a highlight waiting (the count on its corner), and More opens with a Sign in button first that opens the sign-in pane
results.note: bar at y=8; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; sign-in filled (rgb(224, 123, 76)) and kept its icon with a highlight waiting; More → Sign in opened the sign-in pane
